# Siemens DCA-140/DCA-540 Driver

**Author:** Siemens AG; modifications — artold, SARS<br/>
**Platforms:** x10/x25 (HIGOLD), x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD), x65/x75 (SGOLD), ODM, BREW

The drivers are intended for Siemens DCA-140 and DCA-540 USB cables. The official
1.05 package contains INF and system files for Windows 98/ME and Windows
2000/XP, as well as a driver removal utility.

The artold package adds DCA-140 support for Windows XP x64 and Windows 7 x64.
File transfer between the computer and the phone works, including through the
SOFS plugin for Total Commander; modem operation has not been confirmed by the
package author.

The SARS modification allows installing DCA-140 in 32-bit and 64-bit Windows 10
as `Modem Interface`. The driver works with file managers, including SiMoCo
and the VSFE plugins for Total Commander and FAR Manager.
